decisive_items: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
response.rationale: Specific histological features of the tumor cells, such as high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and frequent mitotic figures, are more indicative of hepatocellular carcinoma than hepatic neoplasia in general

rejected.why: Lack of specific malignant features in the provided text spans
